commits.messageBody:
Mirror the client PCH wrapper around balanced STLport vendor includes. Limit C4103 suppression to that include scope and restore it afterward; do not change packing. The guard leaves Linux and Win32 untouched.

Client VS2013 probes preserve before/after layout in four configurations, compile under /WX, and still reject a deliberate packing warning after this header. This is not a native Windows build of the server or validation of its newer Crypto++ sources.

(cherry picked from commit 78ec0f03f48cc6a71730ca8fcdf5ec3546c3a8d8)
commits.messageHeadline: crypto: scope the Windows x64 vendor packing diagnostic
